description: Insider trading from SEC Form 4: the latest Form 4 filings for a ticker or CIK parsed from EDGAR ownershipDocument XML. Reporting owner and role, every transaction (code + meaning, shares, price, value, acquired/disposed, holdings after, derivative details) and open-market buy/sell totals. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sec-form4

company.description: Ticker, CIK or company name of the issuer (or an insider's CIK). Aliases: ticker, cik

limit.description: Number of most recent Form 4 filings to parse (1-25, default 10)

type.description: Filter transactions: all (default), buys (acquired), sells (disposed), open-market (codes P/S only)

name: sec_form4
title: Sec Form4
